status: built for the owner's phone; shipped, not yet heard in the app
why: owner, about the listening page's music sketch: "also changing the music after you marked a class was super cool"; and, about repetition in the room's music, "that fire thing was because that fire sound on repeat was annoying" (so the one 53 s form is played in six performances)
recipe: tool/author_class_day_score.py: the sketch's renderer (render_music.py) carried over, stems unfolded; the song (the 16 bars, the chords, the bass line) is shared and a performance changes only the keys' voicings, hit rhythm and figures, the brushes' pattern and the Evening's slow bells, by the sketch's own controls (seeds, voicing pick, second hit, ghost thump, skipped grain); performance 0 is the sketch note for note. Between = keys (9 kHz lowpass) + 0.55 brushes; Evening = 0.9 keys (900 Hz lowpass, Q 0.6 dB) + 0.35 bass + 1.0 slow bells; each bed gained to -36.0 dBFS phone-band RMS, 50 ms end fade, 6.5 s natural tail; swell k = 0.85 (bass + busy bells) from the circular stems from beat 2k minus 0.15 s, 120 ms cosine rise ending on the beat, two bars held, 0.55 s release, 2.5 s tail, 0.3 s end fade, trimmed to -38.2 dBFS over the held bars; no sample, no foreign synthesis
format: AAC-LC 96 kbps 48 kHz mono, m4a (ffmpeg native aac, bitexact, no metadata)
encoder: ffmpeg version 8.0-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers
runtime_scale: lib/class_day_score.dart plays every file at 1.0 times fades and the shared duck

performances.name: the sketch
performances.feel: The performance on the listening page, note for note.

performances.name: charleston
performances.feel: Nearly every bar gets a second hit on the and of two; the brushes keep the sketch's lean.

performances.name: open hand
performances.feel: Fewer second hits and five short figures on the and of three; a lighter brush that breathes.

performances.name: late push
performances.feel: The keys lay back and answer on the and of three, with four short figures on the and of one; the brushes lean on the offbeats.

performances.name: rolling
performances.feel: A busier hand: second hits on the and of two and of three, four rising figures, ghost thumps and rims on the brushes.

performances.name: close and dry
performances.feel: A drier, closer touch that repeats each voicing more often, four figures; the brushes are softer in the first half and fuller in the second.
